description: Five-launch FP32 GDN-2 chunk prefill with stable causal scores and exact triangular solve.

initial_state.note: K-major, read-only and never aliased with final_state.

o.initialization: NaN poison; every element must be overwritten.

final_state.initialization: NaN poison; every element must be overwritten.

domain.layout: Token-major BTHD inputs/output; K-major BHKV state; all tensors contiguous.
domain.gate_domain: Finite g<=0, erase_gate in [0,2], w in [0,1].
domain.normalization: q and k are normalized in FP32 with eps=1e-6; q is then scaled by 128^-0.5.
domain.ownership: Independent complete chunk/head tiles; scan owns complete heads across chunks.
domain.aliasing: Inputs are read-only; o and final_state are fresh complete-overwrite outputs with disjoint storage.

default.reason: All arithmetic/state are FP32, but CCE register reductions may differ from the CPU reduction tree; bitwise equality is not required.

support.note: All five dynamic-shape stages compiled and executed for all contract cases at block_dim=1 and 8 on 950PR_9589 V100 / CANN 9.2.0; block_dim=2 and 4 remain unqualified.
Native source check at block_dim=8 on 950PR_9589 V100 / CANN 9.2.0; other block counts unqualified.

measured.static: All five stages emitted; zero static errors/warnings. The WY dependent-loop workaround has 128 surface operations.
measured.simulation: After the WY workaround, pipesim passes T=2/H=1 and T=65/H=16 at block_dim=1, checking all 13 stage outputs and synchronization diagnostics.
measured.board_cce: Source workaround 858e380 passes T=4096/H=16/FP32/block_dim=8 on 950PR_9589 V100/CANN 9.2.0, against CPU Torch 2.12.0 references: output relative L2 2.400727462e-6/max abs 1.345761120e-7; state relative L2 4.140812156e-6/max abs 4.950910807e-6. The original 9ba48cd WY failure is retained. Remaining canonical board-launcher cases are untested; see native_inprocess for separate bridge evidence.
measured.latency: In-process Torch NPU synchronized sandwich, 3 rounds, warmup=10/repeat=50, FP32/H=16/block_dim=8: T=1024 median 4260.5555..4370.763 us, T=4096 median 15932.427..16021.0605 us. Baseline is Torch NPU composed per-token recurrence, not an optimized FLA GPU kernel. CPU goldens pass before timing. validation.numerics: Independent FP32 chunk-vs-recurrent tests cover T=1,16,63,64,65,127,128,192,320,1024,4096 at H=16 for zero/strong decay, budget 1e-4. FLA naive recurrence is separately checked. These host tests do not promote unexecuted CCE cases.
validation.synchronization: Reduced block_dim=1 pipesim diagnostics compare all 13 stage outputs; event balance, hazards and deadlock checks pass for the explicitly scoped cases.
